subject: Bangladesh government-hosted Munda / Multiling Cloud archive
purpose: Resolve whether the discovery lead may be deterministically merged with an Indian Mundari [unr] source identity.

authoritative_archive_observations.archive_profile_wording: The archive's Munda profile describes the linguistic heritage using the name Mundari and describes it as spoken by the Munda people in Bangladesh.
authoritative_archive_observations.rights_boundary: Index visibility/open-access wording is not treated as item-level reuse permission, consent, or cultural-access clearance.

external_taxonomy_observations.source: Digital Bible Society language research page
external_taxonomy_observations.observation: Identifies Mundari as ISO 639-3 unr / Glottocode mund1320 and states that it is spoken in eastern India and northern Rangpur Division of Bangladesh.
Separately identifies Munda as a community using Sadri as a lingua franca; this is community/context evidence, not proof that every archive item is ISO unr Mundari.

deterministic_disposition.reason: The Bangladesh archive itself labels the collection Munda while its descriptive prose uses Mundari; external evidence supports Mundari [unr] presence in Bangladesh, but no item-level ISO/glottocode assignment, collection protocol, speaker metadata audit, or authoritative crosswalk was obtained. Automatic identity collapse would therefore be unsafe.

remaining_gates: Authoritative item-level language identifier or collection crosswalk
